title: Variable Force Work Calculation
description: An interactive MicroSim demonstrating how work is calculated for variable forces by showing the area under a force-versus-position graph. Students can experiment with different force functions and see how the integral relates to work.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: work
energy
variable force
integration
calculus
physics
force-position graph
learningObjectives: Understand the key concepts of variable force work calculation
Explore variable force work calculation through interactive visualization
Apply knowledge of variable force work calculation to solve problems
Experiment with parameters to observe their effects on variable force work calculation
